annotationScope.evidencePolicy: Use explicit candidate evidence from the resume and explicit skill categories from the job description. An unresolved first-person contradiction makes the requirement uncertain and keeps the skill out of expected extraction.

cases.resumeText:
Bea Linden
bea.linden@example.com
Recent graduate, visual computing

For my final studio I built a public drinking-fountain map in HTML, CSS and JavaScript. I owned accessibility testing and repaired keyboard focus on the map controls. I used Git to review changes with the teaching assistant. My teammate supplied the Figma mockups. I worked from the exported screenshots.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Junior Civic Web Developer
Help the town's small web team build pages for parks and public facilities.
Required skills: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Accessibility.
Preferred skills: Git and Figma.
cases.notes: The applicant built the map, performed accessibility testing, and used Git. The teammate authored the Figma mockups, and the applicant only used screenshots.

cases.resumeText:
Ellis Corven <ellis.corven@example.net>
Ecology BSc | Capstone on reed bed recovery

I wrote Python and pandas scripts for a one-time cleanup of four seasons of survey data. Separately, my scikit-learn classifier flagged records for a second field visit. I queried local survey records with SQL. The survey coordinator maintained Postgres and sent me the CSV exports I worked from.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Graduate Environmental Data Analyst
Turn incoming wetland observations into reports for field staff.
Required skills
- Python
- Pandas
- SQL

Preferred skills
- Scikit-Learn
- PostgreSQL
- Data Pipelines
cases.notes: The applicant names three tools and SQL in their own work. Postgres belongs to the survey coordinator. The one-off analysis scripts do not establish explicit data pipeline experience.

cases.resumeText:
Applicant: Dario Keswick
Email: dario.keswick@example.org

Diploma in software development. My assessed project tracked loans of portable recorders. I wrote the Java service with Spring Boot, exposed a RESTful API and added a MySQL store. I packaged the service with Docker. The department technician alone handled the Linux host. I submitted a container image and a user guide.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Associate Library Systems Developer
Build and maintain small services for the equipment lending desk.
Required skills are Java, Spring Boot, REST API and MySQL.
Preferred skills are Docker and Linux.
cases.notes: The RESTful API is the applicant's work and maps to REST API. The technician exclusively managed the Linux host.

cases.resumeText:
Mina Bellmere | mina.bellmere@example.com
Museum studies graduate

Volunteer placement with a print museum. I conducted user research with eleven first-time members. I built the renewal screens in Figma and ran A/B testing on two versions of the invitation email. The museum board owned product strategy and roadmapping throughout the placement, and neither was part of my assignment.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Associate Membership Product Analyst
Improve the first year of the museum membership experience.
Required skills: User Research, A/B Testing.
Preferred skills: Figma, Product Strategy, Roadmapping.
cases.notes: The applicant names and performs the research, prototyping, and testing. The board owned the two planning skills, which the applicant expressly excludes from their assignment.

cases.resumeText:
Applicant for controls roles
Owen Quist
owen.quist@example.org

In my mechatronics capstone, I programmed a greenhouse cart in C++. I implemented pathfinding algorithms and designed the data structures for obstacle storage. I kept my controller code in Git. Our technician ran his own Python logger for the demonstrations. I never used the logger or wrote Python for the project.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Graduate Robotics Programmer
Write controller code for carts moving through narrow planting rows.
Required: C++, Algorithms, Data Structures.
Preferred: Python, Git, Linux.
cases.notes: The applicant programmed the controller and names their algorithm, data structure, and version-control work. Python appears only in third-party evidence and a denial. Linux is absent.

cases.resumeText:
Test placement handover, submitted by Rhea Dunvale (rhea.dunvale@example.net)

On a theatre ticketing placement I wrote TypeScript assertions in Jest and browser checks in Cypress. I added the suites to the CI/CD workflow and opened changes through Git. For one browser suite I also wrote HTML fixtures for blank checkout states. My placement finished in June.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Junior Test Automation Engineer
Add regression coverage to ticket reservations and refunds.
Required skills: TypeScript, Cypress, CI/CD.
Preferred skills: Jest, Git, Docker.
cases.notes: The handover identifies its submitter. The applicant explicitly authored HTML fixtures in addition to using the testing stack. Docker has no evidence.

cases.resumeText:
Niko Tern — niko.tern@example.org
Backend Engineer, regional freight dispatch (2018–2025)

I wrote Golang microservices that sequenced trailer arrivals. I owned system design for the reassignment service, including its Kafka consumers, Postgres writes and Redis leases. I maintained the RESTful APIs used by dispatchers. A separate infrastructure team worked in Kubernetes. I read the application logs they exported to a dashboard and never used Kubernetes.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Senior Freight Platform Engineer
Own dispatch services and their event processing.
Required skills: Go, Kafka, PostgreSQL, System Design, Microservices.
Preferred skills: Kubernetes, Redis, Terraform.
cases.notes: Golang, Postgres and RESTful APIs normalize to canonical skill labels. The applicant consumed exported logs and explicitly denies using Kubernetes.

cases.resumeText:
Solene Greywick
solene.greywick@example.com
Applications Engineer | Municipal Permitting

2016–2024. I maintained a C# and .NET system for permit renewals and wrote SQL to reconcile payment records. I set up its Azure deployment and CI/CD. I also implemented a REST API for checking application status. The legacy renewal service stayed on the same stack through my departure.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Senior Municipal Applications Engineer
Maintain the permit renewal and payment services.
Required skills are C#, .NET, SQL and Azure.
Preferred skills are REST API, CI/CD and Docker.
cases.notes: The applicant describes direct ownership of the application, queries, deployment and API. There is no Docker evidence.

cases.resumeText:
Inez Starling / inez.starling@example.net
2017–2025, online instrument shop

Rewrote the stock reservation flow in PHP and Laravel. Tuned MySQL queries and maintained the Redis cache. I rebuilt the Elasticsearch index for used instruments and ran the maintenance scripts on Linux. I managed changes with Git. The hosting vendor handled AWS. My account did not have access to their AWS resources.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Senior Catalog Engineer
Maintain inventory, stock reservations and search for the instrument catalog.
Required skills
* PHP
* Laravel
* MySQL
* Elasticsearch
Preferred skills
* AWS
* Redis
* Linux
cases.notes: The applicant used the catalog and maintenance tools, including Git. AWS access and use belonged to the vendor.

cases.resumeText:
Cal Rooksen
Contact: cal.rooksen@example.org
Applied scientist, crop image inspection, 2019–2025

I built machine learning models in Python and PyTorch to identify leaf damage. I maintained the data pipelines for field imagery and used Pandas to audit the sample counts. I packaged inference with Docker and ran training on AWS. I have never used TensorFlow.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Computer Vision Scientist
Build image models and maintain the datasets that feed them.
Required skills: Python, Machine Learning, PyTorch, Data Pipelines.
Preferred skills: TensorFlow, AWS, Docker.
cases.notes: The work history explicitly names the domain skills and tools the applicant used. TensorFlow is a denial with no positive evidence.

cases.resumeText:
Frontend portfolio excerpt
Ada Penlow, ada.penlow@example.com

At a scholarly archive from 2019 to 2025 I replaced the reading room site with ReactJS, Next.js and TypeScript. I maintained the CSS and fixed accessibility issues for readers using screen readers. I wrote Jest tests for page navigation. Our designers used Figma and provided PNG exports. I did not use Figma.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Senior Archive Frontend Engineer
Develop interfaces for reading and navigating scanned material.
Required skills: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Accessibility.
Preferred skills: Figma, Jest, Redux.
cases.notes: ReactJS maps to React. The applicant authored the frontend and tests. Figma belongs to designers, and Redux is absent.

cases.resumeText:
Jules Merren • jules.merren@example.net
Product director for an island ferry operator, 2018–2025

My remit was product strategy and roadmapping for passenger reservations. I ran user research on missed sailings and A/B testing on fare explanations. My leadership work included coaching three product managers. I was responsible for stakeholder communication with terminal supervisors during launches. Our operations group used Scrum without my involvement.
cases.jobDescriptionText:
Passenger Experience Product Lead
Set the direction for self-service reservations and disruption notices.
Required skills include Product Strategy, Roadmapping and Leadership.
Preferred skills include A/B Testing, User Research, Communication and Scrum.
cases.notes: The applicant explicitly identifies leadership and communication responsibilities as well as planning, testing and research. Scrum was used by a separate group.

Water testing lab automation
